hypotheses.R0_feature_chart_span_is_expressive: The feature-specific 64-chart span reaches at least 0.75 median held-out gradient cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.R1_path_retrieval_beats_feature_mean: Four-neighbor full-path retrieval beats the feature-mean gradient by at least 0.10 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.R2_path_retrieval_beats_position_lookup: Four-neighbor full-path retrieval beats exact-position chart averaging by at least 0.05 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.R3_weight_attention_signature_beats_sour: Four-neighbor weight-derived attention-pattern retrieval beats source-output retrieval by at least 0.05 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.R4_path_retrieval_is_not_only_position: Excluding all same-position charts reduces path-retrieval cosine by at most 0.10 at every layer.
hypotheses.R5_path_retrieval_beats_shuffled_chart_m: Path retrieval exceeds a frozen within-feature shuffled chart assignment by at least 0.10 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.R6_path_retrieval_preserves_leverage: Path-retrieved top-64 supports retain at least 50 percent of exact top-64 first-order leverage in the median at every layer.
hypotheses.R7_path_retrieval_is_finitely_directiona: Path-retrieved top-64 finite patches increase the semantic score on at least 75 percent of examples at every layer.
